name: Aberrant Cultist

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

spellcasting.name: Counterspell (2/Day)
headerEntries: The cultist casts {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} in response to that spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The cultist makes two Tentacle Lash attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Mind Rot.

action.name: Tentacle Lash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d6 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 17}) from one of two tentacles, and it has the {@condition Restrained|XPHB} condition until the grapple ends.

action.name: Mind Rot
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 18}, one creature the cultist can see within 90 feet. {@actSaveFail} 40 ({@damage 9d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition until the start of the cultist's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Elite (Modo Fatal · 5 PJs nível 14)
entries: Versão nivelada para cima: PV ×1,6, CA +2, ataques, salvaguardas e CDs +3, dados de dano ×1,5 e +3 de dano fixo. ND efetivo +3.

fluffEntries: Aberrant Cultist: stat block oficial XMM (5.5e), elevado ao ND 11 para o modo fatal.
